understood_as: Evaluate one new frozen-policy condition D only: follow carry-persistent B, but after the first positive-inventory handoff, execute the source actor exactly once at the first empty-inventory state where source and adapted argmax actions differ, then use the adapted actor until termination.
research_question: Were the four B-failure/C-success paths recovered by one specific source-actor action, or did they require continued inventory-gated policy selection?

new_mode.D_one_action_swap: Use the source actor before the first state with carried_grain > 0. From that first positive-inventory state onward use the adapted actor, except at the first later state where carried_grain == 0 and the source and adapted deterministic argmax actions differ: execute the source action exactly once. Use the adapted actor thereafter, including in later empty-inventory states.
new_mode.no_disagreement: If no eligible action disagreement occurs, D is identical to B and performs no swap.
new_mode.selection_rule: The branch depends only on handoff history, current carried_grain, and the two frozen argmax actions. Success and future outcomes are not consulted.

record: executed risky-harvest count over the entire path, including before the swap
evaluation.exact_formula: For each successful fixed-kernel deterministic D path i with length T_i and full-path risky-harvest count k_i, J_D(p)=mean[0.995^(T_i-1)*(1-p)^k_i]. A fired overwrite destroys physical grain and makes delivery of three impossible in this fixture.

diagnostic_panel.definition: All pinned cases where B carry-persistent fails on the fixed kernel and C carry-gated succeeds.
diagnostic_panel.primary_outcome: Number and identities of these four paths that D recovers.

analysis.paired_by: seed, source checkpoint, adapted checkpoint, and natural start
analysis.primary_metric: D recovery count among the four pinned B-failure/C-success paths
secondary_metrics: whole-panel fixed-kernel success and p=0.05 expected discounted return
whole-panel risky-path count and full-path executed risky-harvest count
new D failures among paths where B succeeds

decision_rule.all_four: A single source action was sufficient for these four observed failures; this does not establish sufficiency outside the fixed panel.
decision_rule.some: The panel mixes failures recoverable by one action with failures requiring a different or longer intervention.
decision_rule.none_while_C_succeeds: The first source action alone was insufficient on these paths; this does not prove that every later C selection was necessary.
decision_rule.success_with_worse_risk_or_return: Normal-task recovery and rare-defect performance must be reported separately.

non_claims: D is an evaluator-supplied rule, not a learned selector.
The four diagnostic cases were defined from pinned B/C outcomes before D execution; they are not a fresh generalization panel.
A successful one-action intervention does not identify a semantic bug fix or establish that the same action works in unseen states.

B/C agreement before the branch follows from identical initial states, deterministic transitions, and identical chosen-action prefixes; stored summaries do not independently encode every latent state field.
Exact p=0.05 values are finite-panel expectations derived from deterministic fixed paths, not stochastic-policy rollouts.
Five Dual-history learner seeds do not establish population frequency or significance.

stop_rule: Run D for all five seeds and 32 natural starts on the fixed kernel, compute p=0 and p=0.05, compare with pinned B and C, and do not add learning, seeds, kernels, repeated swaps, thresholds, or follow-up variants.
